name: Wo S Hou di Naxie Tian
source:
This is a suspenseful, mystery-driven story. Some say that after death, people go to heaven. But in this story, the female protagonist you play as not only doesn’t make it to heaven—she wakes up lying next to her own corpse.

What’s it like to discover, after death, that you’ve been dragged into a serial murder case? And what’s it like to realize, after being reborn, that the person you’ve been flirting with is deeply connected to your own murder?

Welcome to The Days After My Death, a story that offers a unique psychological experience.

______
You’re sitting in front of the TV, watching the news: “Last night, a young woman was found dead in a dark alley.” That young woman—is you.

When you wake up, you find yourself reborn as a journalist named An Ruo. While working, you use your professional connections to investigate the truth behind your previous life’s death.

During your investigation, you meet the detective handling your case and An Ruo’s psychologist. What kind of story will unfold between you and them?

As the truth behind a series of murders slowly comes to light, you discover that An Ruo’s love interest is intricately tied to the case.

God has given you a second chance at life, a chance to seek justice for yourself. Every decision you make will affect the clues surrounding your murder.

What is the afterlife like? Reality tells you—it’s exactly the same as before!

Not only has nothing changed, but now, as a reborn version of yourself, you must also track down the person who killed you. How will you find the killer?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904220/After_Death/]steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个以悬疑与推理为主线的故事。有人说，人死后会去天堂。但在这里，你扮演的女主角非但没能进入天堂，反而一睁眼就发现，自己正躺在自己的尸体旁边。

死后才发现自己卷入了一桩连环杀人案，是什么体验？重生后才发现，与你暧昧的人和你的死有着密切关联，又是什么体验？

欢迎来到《我S后的那些天》，体验一段别样的心理历程。

______
你坐在电视机前，看着新闻播报：“昨夜，一名年轻女子遇害，尸体在一处幽暗的小巷中被发现。”那个年轻女子——就是你。

醒来后，你发现自己重生成了一名叫安若的记者。工作之余，你利用职业上的人脉，调查自己前世死亡的真相。

调查过程中，你结识了负责你那起案件的刑警，以及安若的心理医生。你与他们之间，会发生怎样的故事？

随着一系列凶杀案的真相逐渐浮出水面，你发现安若倾心的人与案件有着千丝万缕的联系。

上天给了你第二次生命，也给了你为自己讨回公道的机会。你的每一个决定，都会影响与你被杀一案有关的线索。

死后的世界是什么样子？现实告诉你——和以前一模一样！

不但什么都没改变，重获新生的你还必须追查杀害自己的凶手。你究竟该如何找到他？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904220/After_Death/]Steam[/url]]
